case.label: C
case.text: A custom health check that reports a failed web server to the Auto Scaling API as unhealthy would also get the failed instance replaced, so C does meet the requirement and a candidate can defend it. It loses only on the phrase LEAST operational overhead, because it needs an agent, a one-minute test and API permissions on every instance, while B is one setting. The stem also never says that the target group is attached to the group; B depends on that, but the phrase 'behind an Application Load Balancer' and 'target group checks the health' make it a safe reading. Wording cues that give B away: 'uses only the default Amazon EC2 health checks' and 'the group acts on the health that the target group reports'.
